wikibaseontologypresets-desc: Applies a curated property preset to a new Wikibase
ontologypresets-summary: Start your Wikibase with a preconfigured set of properties instead of creating them by hand. Presets are optional and can only be added while your Wikibase has no properties yet.
ontologypresets-invalid-token: Your session token was invalid. Please try again.
ontologypresets-preset-description: $1 basic {{PLURAL:$1|property|properties}} that almost every Wikibase can use, such as instance of, subclass of and formatter URL. Tools like OpenRefine need them. Each property is linked to Wikidata and has English labels and descriptions. Curated by the Wikibase community.
ontologypresets-apply-confirmation: This adds the $1 set to your Wikibase. You can edit or delete the properties later. These properties will get the first IDs (P1 to $2).
